def choose_move(observation):
    sx = observation.get("self_position", [0, 0])[0]
    sy = observation.get("self_position", [0, 0])[1]
    ox = observation.get("opponent_position", [0, 0])[0]
    oy = observation.get("opponent_position", [0, 0])[1]
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    grid_width = observation.get("grid_width", 10)
    grid_height = observation.get("grid_height", 10)

    # Defensive retrieval with get
    def get_field(field, default=None):
        return observation.get(field, default)

    # Utility function to determine direction towards target
    def direction_towards(source_x, source_y, target_x, target_y):
        dx = 0
        dy = 0
        if target_x != source_x:
            dx = 1 if target_x > source_x else -1
        if target_y != source_y:
            dy = 1 if target_y > source_y else -1
        return dx, dy

    # For pursuit_evasion environment
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = get_field("self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx, dy = direction_towards(sx, sy, ox, oy)
            return [dx, dy]
        corners = [
            [0, 0],
            [0, grid_height - 1],
            [grid_width - 1, 0],
            [grid_width - 1, grid_height - 1]
        ]
        target = max(corners, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - ox) + abs(c[1] - oy))
        dx, dy = direction_towards(sx, sy, target[0], target[1])
        return [dx, dy]

    # For territory_control environment
    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = get_field("unclaimed_cells") or get_field("opponent_territory") or []
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        best = min(targets, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - sx) + abs(c[1] - sy))
        dx, dy = direction_towards(sx, sy, best[0], best[1])
        return [dx, dy]

    # For resource_collection environment
    resources = get_field("resources") or []
    if not resources:
        dx, dy = direction_towards(sx, sy, ox, oy)
        return [dx, dy]

    best_resource = min(resources, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - sx) + abs(c[1] - sy))
    dx, dy = direction_towards(sx, sy, best_resource[0], best_resource[1])
    return [dx, dy]
